en: • A successor to the 2000 series, which was introduced in 19982, is a vehicle with improved comfort and comfort.

• A set of 1 car in front (2 types of roofs: 2 types without pantoas) and 1 car in the middle (2 types of roofs: 2 types with pantographs/no pantographs).
